purpose: Turn customer-authorized observed choices and compliant public-market evidence into versioned calibration inputs. Public web evidence may enrich product and competitor attributes; it must never be treated as sales, conversion, or an observed consumer choice.

evidence_tiers.name: Verified public market evidence
collection_controls: content hash and source URL lineage

requirements: one chosen option per choice set
at least one varying numeric feature

platform_pooling.stored_data: deidentified coefficient summaries, uncertainty and sample counts only

collection_cadence.public_price_and_promotion: per professional study plus weekly category refresh where permitted
collection_cadence.customer_observed_choices: continuous; publish a new version only after quality gates pass
collection_cadence.operations_history: daily or hourly where a venue study is in scope
collection_cadence.holdout_validation: monthly or after each material campaign

lineage.report_rule: Every result must state whether it is official aggregate data, observed customer data, public evidence, or a model prior.

privacy.public_web_scope: No login cookies, private endpoints, personal profiles, CAPTCHA bypasses, or collection that contravenes access controls.
privacy.customer_data_scope: Use only authorized business data. Remove direct identifiers before upload; raw choice rows are not embedded in reports or platform pooling.
